name: Miyakura Yoshino
source:
Masaya's aunt and sister of his deceased mother. Since Masaya came to the village, she helps him with everything as a maid.

In "Tegome ni Sareru  Kyuunin no Otome" she isn't the protagonist's aunt but only the housekeeper of the place he goes to live. She became the housekeeper to look for a chance to exact revenge against house she is serving, with the help of the protagonist
